imaging.scope: all inventoried units and raw archives; no selection by spatial or clinical effect
imaging.unit: separate tissue or source FOV, no cross-FOV neighbors
imaging.classifier: same50label reference, independent train/heldout replay on native common genes; multinomial logistic L2 C1 class_weight balanced seed2026110703
imaging.coarse_fallback: same-major reference diagnostic at same gate, explicitly broad context not exact CM subtype replication
imaging.replicate_handling: technical replicates retained, not independent patients

imaging.spatial_recurrence_scope: descriptive reference-conditioned replication first; no claim of contact or causality from CellChat alone

bulk.program_derivation: current same164sample CMT pseudobulk mean native CP10K then log1p, Seurat sample-level Wilcoxon; top10 positive avg_log2FC after adjP<.05 logFC>.25; no clinical outcomes
bulk.score: mean gene-wise within-cancer/cohort patient percentile of all10 frozen genes; no missing-gene substitution, no high-low cutpoint
bulk.paper_relation: paper CMT pseudobulk signature concept; clinical percentile scoring explicit project extension, not exact author AddModuleScore classification
bulk.TCGA_material: 01 primary solid tumour only; patient collapse and conflicting clinical records excluded
bulk.TCGA_gate: n>=60; events>=max(20,10*p); overall stage coverage>=70%; full rank; condition number<=1e6
bulk.ICI_response_definition: CR/PR vs SD/PD; NE and unknown missing; only verified pre-treatment for Riaz/Hugo, Rose archived timing separate
bulk.adjustment: pan-T for ICI, age/sex/pan-T and stage sensitivity for TCGA
bulk.TCGA_immune: cancer-specific C1-C6 omnibus Kruskal; disjoint-gene checkpoint/CYT/PTPRC associations; no pooled cancer P
bulk.FDR: BH/BY complete separate TCGA_survival(1848), ICI_response(84), ICI_survival(168), TCGA_immune(4620); unavailable slots p1 in correction and NA shown
bulk.SU2C_rule: full author public expression and exact Keep QC required; 34gene old panel insufficient for new CM programs, retain pending slots if absent
bulk.source_overlap_and_patient_bridge: not yet certified; no formal independent clinical validation claim
